_comment: Copy to <data dir>/profiles/<CC>.json (or run `pcp profile import this.json`) and edit. Only country, currency and timezone are required; everything else has a safe default. Facts must come from the user or from cited live research, never from memory. Mark verified:true only after checking sources.
label: Country name
locale: BCP-47 locale for number formatting, e.g. en-US

prefix: symbol or code that appears BEFORE a price
suffix: symbol or code that appears AFTER a price

local_terms: words sellers use for condition, warranty, import status
sanity_note: Sanity range, not a price claim.
notes: taxes, warranty customs, seasonal patterns the agent verified
